item.title: Over 1 Cr women to receive Rs 5,000 Cr under Subhadra Yojana, scheme strengthening financial security across Odisha
item.description: The Subhadra Yojana has emerged as a major welfare initiative aimed at supporting women across Odisha through direct financial assistance. As part of the scheme’s continued implementation, the fourth instalment of the Subhadra Yojana will be released on Sunday. More than Rs 5,000 crore will be transferred through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank accounts of over 1.2 crore eligible beneficiaries across the state. item.title: Ganjam administration’s initiative bears fruit as 5 candidates crack UPSC CSE 2025
item.description: The Ganjam district administration is celebrating a significant milestone as five candidates from Odisha, coached by the newly launched Ganjam Lakshya Niketan (GLN), have successfully qualified for the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025. item.title: Police seize 586 kg ganja hidden in pickup van in Odisha’s Rayagada
item.description: Police in Odisha’s Rayagada district seized 586 kg of cannabis concealed in a pickup van transporting vegetables and arrested one person during an operation on Sunday. The accused has been identified as Biswambar Naik of Narangabadi village. The vehicle used to transport the contraband has also been seized.
